otherInfo: AgentPay — micropayment gateway for the AI agent economy on Solana. Any API becomes pay-per-request with 3 lines of code: the server replies HTTP 402 with Solana payment instructions, the agent pays on-chain (System Program transfer + unique memo), retries with the tx signature, and the gateway verifies amount + memo on-chain before serving. No accounts, no API keys, no chargebacks — the transaction is the credential. Devnet implementation includes: gateway core, autonomous agent client, zero-dependency demo API, and demo site. Business model: open-source SDK -> hosted gateway at 0.5% per settled request -> enterprise SLA. GTM: Solana ecosystem APIs and AI-agent projects building on Superteam Earn right now.
